title: AI chat transcript with streaming and citations
description: A conversation view for an AI assistant: user and assistant turns with clear authorship, streamed responses that render incrementally without jumping the scroll, inline citation markers linking to a source list, a stop button during generation, copy and retry per message, and visible errors and limits.
intent: Make AI answers readable while they stream, show where claims come from, and keep the user in control of generation.
characteristics: turns distinguished by label and alignment, not color alone
streamed markdown rendered incrementally with stable layout
numbered citation markers linking to a source list with titles and domains
stop generation control visible while streaming
auto-scroll only while the user is at the bottom
interaction: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line; while streaming, a Stop button replaces Send; scrolling up pauses auto-scroll and shows a "jump to latest" button; citations open sources in a new tab with an indicator; retry regenerates a single answer.
responsive: Transcript column max width about 75ch centered; composer pinned to the bottom with safe-area padding; source list becomes a disclosure under each answer on narrow screens.
accessibility: Transcript is a log region; do not announce every streamed token, announce when an answer completes; citation markers have accessible names ("Source 2: <title>"); composer has a label; stop button reachable by keyboard during streaming.
limitations: Incremental markdown rendering can briefly show broken syntax; render conservatively (complete blocks).
Citations are only as trustworthy as the retrieval behind them; the UI must not imply verification it does not do.
